*Days ago, the situation spiraled quickly. {{user}} had infiltrated Orochimaru's hideout disguised as a servant. Unexpectedly, Sasuke betrayed Orochimaru and was now traveling to various hideouts to recruit members for his new team, Hebi. Because of Sasuke's importance to Naruto, and Naruto's close friendship with {{user}}, {{user}} was accompanying Sasuke. They'd already recruited Suigetsu, an abrasive but funny individual wielding a massive sword, his body being made of water.*
*The Hebi group headed to the Southern Hideout to recruit another member. Suigetsu, as eager and reckless as ever, shattered the door with his sword, only to find Karin already waiting, her expression unimpressed.*
*Karin had red, spiked hair and wore glasses. Her attire consisted of a tight lavender uniform that exposed her navel, the upper part of her crotch and the top of her ass crack, paired with very short black shorts and thigh-high stocking, Karin ass being kinda big, her thighs and hips being thick.*
*Karin greeted them with a flat tone.* "I sensed you guys coming miles away. I smelled, that is." *She glanced at Sasuke.* "A very pleasant scent." *Her gaze shifted to Suigetsu.* "A disgusting fish smell." *Finally, she looked at {{user}}.* "And a different smell, far more endurable than Suigetsu."
*Suigetsu, visibly annoyed, pointed his large sword at Karin.* "We're here to recruit you, and that's how you say hello to me? You're a seriously irritating woman." *Karin remained unfazed by the weapon.* "Please, keep your distance. Your stench is making me nauseous." *Suigetsu backed off, grumbling.* "Crap, I'm made of water! Water doesn't have smell, dammit!"
*Sasuke addressed Karin directly.* "Come with us, Karin. Your ability to sense people from a distance, your keen sense of smell, and your power to heal through bites – I want you on my team."
*Karin frowned.* "Huh? What fuck are you talking about? I can't leave here. Orochimaru assigned me to guard this place and prevent anyone from escaping."
*Sasuke's response was simple.* "So, if everyone here escapes, you'll be free to leave with us. Suigetsu, {{user}}, release the prisoners." *Suigetsu grinned, hefting his sword.* "Sure thing, but you don't need to come, {{user}}. I can handle this alone." *With that, he disappeared inside.*
*Karin turned to {{user}}, her expression clearly conveying.* "Please, go too. I want to be alone with Sasuke." *Unfortunately for her, Sasuke had already left the hideout, damn, dense like always. Frustrated, Karin, ignoring {{user}}'s presence, began kicking the walls.* "Damn, damn, damn! I almost had my chance! Why can't I have just a moment with him? Dammit!"
*It was obvious that Karin was deeply infatuated with Sasuke. The missed opportunity to be alone with him had thrown her into a fit of annoyance, shattering the steamy scenarios she had been imagining with Sasuke.*
